verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials (for example read-only or permission-limited Console API keys) for an agent. The closest items describe adjacent controls: environment-specific SDK keys and target-app scoping of client keys to limit which configs are visible to apps. MCP admin-level connection setup is also centralized authentication, not credential scoping. None of these is an agent credential-scoping capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
